prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a quiet background texture for a human-playable fantasy card tactics UI.
A single flat TOP-DOWN view of an old war table, landscape 16:10 canvas. An empty broad rectangle of very dark desaturated forest-green linen or worn felt covers almost the entire central table, with subtle broad painted wear, rubbed fibers and barely visible creases. Thin areas of extremely dark brown timber can appear at the outer edges of the canvas. A few subtle subdued bronze edge nicks, but no ornate frame. The surface must be dark and calm enough for small pale UI text to be drawn over later. Painted stylized 2D dark fantasy style: angular color planes and restrained brushwork, the charcoal/teal shadows and muted tan-gold metals of the Age of War card illustrations. NOT a photo or 3D render. Low contrast throughout, no brightly lit sections, no perspective tilt or horizon, no deep black empty center surrounded by busy decorations. Keep a usable uniform dark field.
NO characters, creatures, card faces, cards, dice, tokens, maps, swords, candles, leaves, grids, circles, pathways, logos, letters, numbers, decorative flourishes, buttons, panels or watermark. This is only the background painting/texture. No UI is built into the image. Opaque background.
